blocks.text: At **15,000 square feet**, a corporate headquarters outgrows small-suite trip minimums and enters the **10,000–24,999 sq ft commercial pricing bracket** (**$0.07 to $0.12 per sq ft per visit**). Unlike a 2,500 sq ft branch office where one cleaner finishes trash, dusting, and restrooms in under an hour, a 15,000 sq ft layout typically spans an executive reception area, two to four glass-walled conference rooms, a central breakroom, open-plan workstations, and **4 multi-fixture restrooms**.

Because setup and drive time amortize across a much larger floor plate, per-square-foot efficiency improves noticeably over smaller suites documented in our [Office Cleaning Cost Guides](/office-cleaning-cost-guides/). However, hybrid attendance patterns mean choosing between a **3x/week** Tuesday/Wednesday/Thursday anchor schedule and a full **5x/week** weekday retainer can swing annual operating costs by nearly **$96,000 to $167,000**.
Per-Visit, Weekly, Monthly, and Annual Cost Breakdown for 15,000 Sq Ft

Our baseline model pairs **15,000 cleanable sq ft** of commercial carpet (**1.00x flooring factor**) with **4 restrooms** (**$60 to $120 per visit** at **$15 to $30 per restroom**) at the **1.00x US national average**. Notice how the frequency multiplier rewards higher cadence: monthly deep-soil visits carry a **1.28x penalty** because overflowing waste, beverage stains, and restroom mineral buildup take longer to clear, while **3x/week (0.95x)** and **5x/week (0.90x)** schedules drop the per-visit rate back down to **$0.07 to $0.12 effective per sq ft**.

blocks.title: Why 3x/Week Beats 5x/Week for Hybrid 15,000 Sq Ft Headquarters
blocks.text: If peak in-office headcount runs Tuesday through Thursday, dropping from 5x/week ($21,758–$37,671/mo across 21.65 visits) to 3x/week ($13,748–$23,790/mo across 13.00 visits) saves $8,010 to $13,881 every month while adding only $53 to $90 per visit in frequency adjustment. Keep restrooms stocked for light Monday/Friday traffic and audit odor control before cutting below three visits.
How Flooring Surfaces and Scope Add-Ons Shift Your Headquarters Budget

Most 15,000 sq ft headquarters blend two or more floor materials—typically modular carpet tiles across desk bays paired with engineered hardwood in the lobby, VCT or LVT vinyl in corridors and copy rooms, and ceramic tile in restrooms and breakrooms. When hard surfaces exceed 30% of the floor plate, contractors price the suite under the **Mixed (1.05x)** or **Engineered Hardwood (1.08x)** multiplier rather than pure carpet.

Equally important are the four optional add-ons that frequently trigger change orders when omitted from an RFP. Including a central **breakroom and kitchenette** adds **$12 to $25 per visit**; detailing **interior conference glass** adds **$15 to $35 per visit**; having the vendor supply **paper and soap consumables** adds **$0.012 to $0.025 per sq ft per visit** (**$180 to $375 per visit** at 15,000 sq ft); and amortizing **quarterly deep floor care** (hot-water carpet extraction or VCT scrub-and-recoat) adds **$0.03 to $0.06 per sq ft per month** (**$450 to $900 per month**).

blocks.text: Labor Hours, Crew Sizing, and Regional Metro Rate Variations

Using the **ISSA production benchmark of roughly 3,500 sq ft per labor hour** (ranging from 2,800 sq ft/hr in dense cubicle layouts to 4,000 sq ft/hr in open corridors) plus **0.15 to 0.25 hours per restroom**, a 15,000 sq ft headquarters requires **4.35 to 6.36 technician labor hours per visit**. In practice, reputable vendors dispatch a **two-person crew for a 2.25-to-3.25-hour evening shift** rather than a single custodian working past midnight, which preserves dual-key security and reduces fatigue-driven shortcuts.

Regional wage floors and union density also adjust every line item in the tables above. In **Dallas, TX (0.99x)**, the 3x/week carpeted baseline stays right near the national average at roughly **$1,047 to $1,812 per visit**. In **Chicago, IL (1.22x)**, the same scope rises to roughly **$1,291 to $2,233 per visit** (**$16,773 to $29,024 per month**), while in **New York, NY (1.35x)** it climbs to roughly **$1,428 to $2,471 per visit** (**$18,560 to $32,117 per month**). Notice also that direct hourly labor benchmarks run **$35 to $65 per hour** for routine tasks and **$55 to $95 per hour** for specialty floor restoration or biohazard response; a full-service per-square-foot contract incorporates payroll taxes, Workers' Compensation, supervision, insurance overhead, and equipment depreciation inside the total visit fee.
Hard-Floor Equipment Specs That Protect Surfaces and Shift Speed

When evaluating bids for a 15,000 sq ft mixed-surface headquarters—or stocking an in-house porter closet for daytime spill response—floor tool ergonomics directly protect expensive finishes. Over-wetting engineered wood swells tongue-and-groove seams, while frayed cotton mops leave lint streaks across VCT corridors.

items: **Low-Moisture Engineered Wood Spot Care:** The **O-Cedar ProMist MAX Commercial Microfiber Spray Mop** pairs a **14.5-in double-sided machine-washable pad** with an onboard refillable bottle, letting day porters or evening crews mist neutral cleaner lightly onto coffee spills without dragging a heavy wet bucket across reception wood.

**High-Absorbency VCT & Grout Mopping:** For breakrooms and ceramic restroom floors, the **O-Cedar Commercial 24-oz Looped-End Cotton Wet Mop** uses a launderable **looped-end design with a 5-in heavy-duty tailband** (Blue/White) that prevents tangling and releases soil evenly along grout joints.

**Quarterly VCT Finish Application:** When contractors perform scrub-and-recoat maintenance, the **Rubbermaid Commercial Finish Applicator Flat Mop Kit** uses an **18-in nylon/microfiber Blue/White pad** engineered for **streak-free VCT waxing**, eliminating puddles along baseboards.

blocks.title: Verify Allergen Filtration Before Signing a Carpet-Heavy Bid
blocks.text: Across 15,000 sq ft of commercial carpet, upright vacuums without sealed HEPA exhaust recirculate fine toner and pollen across open cubicles. Specify sealed HEPA filtration in your RFP and benchmark equipment against our guide to the [best commercial vacuums for allergy-sensitive offices](/commercial-vacuums-and-floor-machines/best-commercial-vacuums-for-allergy-sensitive-offices/).
How to Audit Competing Quotes for a 15,000 Sq Ft Office

Whether you are stepping up from an [18,000 sq ft](/office-cleaning-cost-guides/cost-to-clean-a-18000-sq-ft-office/) comparison or downsizing from a [20,000 sq ft](/office-cleaning-cost-guides/cost-to-clean-a-20000-sq-ft-office/) or [25,000 sq ft](/office-cleaning-cost-guides/cost-to-clean-a-25000-sq-ft-office/) floor plate, run every vendor proposal through a standardized audit before awarding the contract.

items.name: Confirm Net Cleanable Square Footage
items.text: Deduct server rooms, locked mechanical closets, and landlord-maintained multi-tenant corridors from your gross lease number so you only pay the $0.07–$0.12/sq ft rate on spaces crews actually service.

items.name: Check the 4.333 Weeks-Per-Month Formula
items.text: Ensure 3x/week monthly retainers are calculated on 13.00 visits/month (52 weeks x 3 / 12) and 5x/week contracts on 21.65 visits/month so fifth-week workdays do not trigger surprise surcharges.

items.name: Separate Paper & Soap Consumables
items.text: Ask vendors to break out tissue, roll towels, soap, and liners ($180–$375/visit) as an optional line item so you can compare vendor markups against direct bulk warehouse ordering.

items.name: Inspect W-2 Staffing, Bonds, and COI Limits
items.text: Require a Certificate of Insurance showing $1M/$2M General Liability naming your company as Additional Insured, statutory Workers' Compensation for W-2 cleaners, and a janitorial surety bond for after-hours keyholders.

blocks.text: Want city-adjusted numbers for your exact restroom count and floor mix? Run your 15,000 sq ft specs in the Office Cleaning Cost Calculator or compare three vendor quotes side by side.

faqs.q: Why do 15,000 sq ft cleaning quotes multiply weekly frequency by 4.333 instead of 4?
faqs.a: Because a 52-week year divided by 12 calendar months equals 4.333 weeks per month (4.33 in rounded pricing calculators). Multiplying 3 visits per week by 4.333 yields 13.00 visits per month, and multiplying 5 visits per week yields 21.65 visits per month. Contracts built on a 4-week month either skip cleaning during five-week months or add extra per-visit charges.

faqs.q: What insurance and COI coverage is mandatory for a 15,000 sq ft headquarters?
faqs.a: Before issuing building access badges, verify a current Certificate of Insurance (COI) with at least $1,000,000 per occurrence and $2,000,000 aggregate Commercial General Liability naming your firm and landlord as Additional Insured, active Workers' Compensation covering W-2 technicians, and a janitorial fidelity bond.

faqs.q: How do OSHA HazCom and Bloodborne Pathogens rules apply to a 15,000 sq ft office?
faqs.a: Under OSHA Hazard Communication (29 CFR 1910.1200), your contractor must keep properly labeled dilution bottles and accessible Safety Data Sheets (SDS) in the janitorial closet. For restroom biohazard incidents, OSHA Bloodborne Pathogens (29 CFR 1910.1030) requires trained staff, PPE, and regulated spill kits, which is why specialty cleanup bills at $55–$95/hr.

faqs.q: Does requiring Green Seal GS-37 chemicals increase a 15,000 sq ft cleaning contract?
faqs.a: In most US metros, specifying Green Seal GS-37 or EPA Safer Choice concentrates adds 0% to 4% to the monthly retainer because wall-mounted dilution dispensers prevent chemical over-pouring. The larger budget factor in LEED-compliant buildings is ensuring crews run certified HEPA vacuums and launderable microfiber pads.

faqs.q: What tasks are excluded from standard $0.07–$0.12/sq ft office cleaning rates?
faqs.a: Routine per-square-foot contracts cover trash and recycling removal, desk and ledge dusting, HEPA vacuuming, damp mopping, and restroom sanitation. They typically exclude hot-water carpet extraction, VCT stripping and waxing ($0.03–$0.06/sq ft/month amortized), exterior glass, high dusting over 10 feet, inside-refrigerator cleanouts, and restroom consumables.
